environment: Staging — this Muse artifact (own server + database). Live payments, courier booking and public sales stay OFF until the owner approves production activation.
financeDecision: Seller payouts / cash-out are FORMALLY EXCLUDED from scope: NEXORA MARKET is a single-company store, so there are no sellers, commissions or payouts to build. Finance scope = customer payments, refunds and reconciliation only.
hostingAssessment: Current platform (assessed, not migrated): this artifact's own server + SQLite database. Data is durable across restarts and every business record above lives in it; Firebase is not available on this platform and no migration has been attempted or claimed.

Persistence & backup: a verified pre-correction snapshot (full JSON export of the business tables + row counts) is stored in the app's blob storage by the correction run and recorded in the audit log; the platform database itself is the canonical store. Recovery = restore from that snapshot export.
Security on this platform: server-side validation, salted PBKDF2 password hashing, server-side role permissions with audit-logged denials, idempotent checkout, no secrets in client code.
Staging URL & PWA: there is NO separate external staging URL and NO installable PWA on this platform — not claimed anywhere in the app.

If external hosting is chosen later: suitable options are a small VPS or Fly.io/Render running the same server bundle; the SQLite schema migrates 1:1 to Postgres/Turso with the Drizzle migrations 0001–0007 as the source of truth; product images move from blob storage to S3/R2-compatible object storage (keys are already storage-relative).

External deployment checklist: environment variables for each provider (names listed in the Deployment Guide below — values never in code), custom domain + HTTPS via the host's certificate automation, nightly database backup + snapshot retention, deploy = build → migrate → smoke-test the Big Test journey → rollback = redeploy the previous build and restore the last snapshot.
pendingOwnerInputs: Payment merchant approvals + sandbox credentials (JazzCash, Easypaisa, card acquirer)
Courier corporate accounts + API credentials (TCS / Leopards / PostEx)
Real company bank account details for Bank Transfer instructions (current ones are fictional demo data)
Legal business details for policies: registered business name, NTN, business address, returns warehouse address
Domain + production hosting decision (Firebase/own hosting) and explicit production-activation approval

Coupon production values: the expiry date and usage limit for coupons 000, WELCOME10 and FLASH500 — deliberately NOT invented by the system. Supply the intended values and they will be applied exactly as given (Admin → Promotions).

Real product photographs for the catalogue: image upload is live (Admin → Products → Edit → Product Photos). Until the owner supplies the real photos, every product shows one representative stock photo clearly labelled "Sample image" (owner instruction, 25 Nov 2026) — the real photographs are still owed and will replace the samples.

Legacy returns decision: RET-DEMO-001 and RET-DEMO-002 fail the current return rules (see Admin → Phase 2 → Big Test Corrections for the exact discrepancies). Choose 'mark as legacy' or the offered correction — the original records are preserved until you decide.
